entries.title: Herman Cherry: Expansiveness and possibility
entries.author: twocoatsstaff
entries.summary: Contributed by Amanda Church / Who else had never heard of Herman Cherry (1909–1992) until images of his spare and radiant paintings suddenly started appearing all over social media? With two NYC gallery shows up, at Sebastian Gladstone in Tribeca and Shamnoski uptown, plus one at Sebastian Gladstone in Los Angeles in 2025, his work is deservedly in the spotlight after almost 20 years.

entries.title: For a utopian realism
entries.author: Simon Garnett
entries.summary: Daniel Cohn Bendit and Claus Leggewie have for decades been two of the most influential and original voices on the European Green-Left. Here they reflect on the limits of anti-authoritarianism, how the Left has become intolerant of ambiguity, and why, when it comes to Europe, utopianism is the better form of realism.
